name: Gyroscope GYD L1 CCIP escrow arbitrary call on message receipt
summary: GydL1CCIPEscrow._ccipReceive transfers the bridged amount and then runs recipient.functionCall(data), with recipient and data taken from the L2 bridger's message. The attacker bridged 1 wei GYD from Arbitrum naming the GYD token as recipient and approve(attacker, max) as data. On delivery the escrow approved the attacker, who pulled the escrow's 6.1M GYD. The attacker then sold 0.82M GYD into Balancer pools on Ethereum and, after bridging part of it back out, on five L2s.

loss.notes: The escrow lost 6,099,337.38 GYD. The USD value is the attacker's realised proceeds from 823,930.68 GYD sold on six chains, because GYD lost its market once those sales drained liquidity (DefiLlama 0.9997 before, 0.7447 after). About 5.27M unsold GYD (4.58M still on Ethereum plus unsold L2 mints) is not valued, so this is a lower bound. The 1.19M GYD re-deposited to mint L2 GYD is attacker routing of stolen funds, not a recovery.

ageReset.description: Last pre-exploit UUPS upgrade selected GydL1CCIPEscrow 0x79ec4a44, whose _ccipReceive makes the message-supplied arbitrary call.

sources.note: Reviewed root cause, first exercise, artifact identity and age. Source-2 (Arbitrum block 426912214) is attacker EOA 0x7dd4075a6eae9f18309f112364f0394c2dfa8102 calling the L2 GYD bridge 0xca5d8f8a8d49439357d3cf46ca2e720702f132b8 selector 0x401030ce; it burns 1 wei GYD and ccipSends to Ethereum a message whose data encodes recipient = L1 GYD 0xe07f9d810a48ab5c3c914ba3ca53af14e4491e8a, amount 1 and call data approve(0x7dd4075a..., 2^256-1). Source-1 (Ethereum block 24350070, index 78) is the CCIP OffRamp 0xdf615ef8d4c64d0ed8fd7824bbed2f6a10245ac9 execution (messageId 0xe5568505d3e5c82ce6194ee92a289f5a48693f23135bf2caad9ec934da863ce9, source selector 0x44ae84d8e9a37444). debug_traceTransaction(callTracer): router 0x80226fc0ee2b096224eeac085bb9a8cba1146f7d CALLs escrow proxy 0xa1886c8d748deb3774225593a70c79454b1da8a6 ccipReceive 0x85572ffb, which DELEGATECALLs 0x79ec4a4440878b25b0cbd902fb3414015c28bbc5. The escrow then CALLs GYD transfer(GYD, 1) and GYD approve(0x7dd4075a..., 2^256-1) from its own context; receipt logs 283 (Transfer) and 284 (Approval owner escrow, spender attacker, max). Source-8 _ccipReceive checks only the source chain's registered sender and then runs recipient.functionCall(data) with message-supplied recipient and data, so any L2 bridger can make the escrow call any contract. Source-3 (block 24350135) uses the allowance: transferFrom(escrow, attacker, 6099337379423890415819985). Identity/age: EIP-1967 slot 0x360894a13ba1a3210667c828492db98dca3e2076cc3735a920a3ca505d382bbc is 0x0bbbf20bd05dbd362e4f021870e5c5acef94ca18 at 20778972 and 0x79ec4a44... at 20778973 and 24350069. Etherscan getLogs Upgraded (topic 0xbc7cd75a20ee27fd9adebab32041f755214dbc6bffa90cc0225b39da2e5c2d3b) on the proxy through block 24350070 returns three events: 19842721 (0x086602c022a4362d48dce1596cd1b7ad6fb38701), 20268438 (0x0bbbf20b...) and source-4 (block 20778973, index 45, log 51, topic1 = 0x79ec4a44..., sent via Safe execTransaction). Implementation runtime is empty at 20778452; keccak 0x9a0cde2770af4153567b8bfca86e4c377c3f5ea618ef8d79772e9207ea479b31 (11024 bytes) at its creation block 20778453 and at 24350069. The proxy runtime keccak 0x6c200b2b841324753921398833799b63769299ed37f9d7a84722457675d59404 is empty at 19842720 and unchanged to 24350069. Source-5 (block 19842721, index 105) CREATEs it from 0xbca8837c4b25e34ea3ff35aec63a2ef68a887079. Earliest exercise: Etherscan tokentx of the escrow from its first transfer (block 19842851) through 24350135 has 270 GYD transfers to 43 distinct recipients. The only recipient with contract code other than 23-byte EIP-7702 delegations is the GYD token itself, in source-1. The L2 message path, chain registration and gas settings are ordinary configuration.

Reviewed loss. Gross escrow depletion: source-3 moves 6099337.379423890415819985 GYD (all but 1 wei; balanceOf at 24350069 = 6099337379423890415819986) to the attacker. The attacker re-deposits 1,190,000 GYD into the escrow through bridgeToken (0xe182dd87) to mint GYD on Arbitrum (700000), Base (250000), Avalanche (220000), Polygon (10000) and Gnosis (10000). DefiLlama quotes GYD 0.99973 at 1769803139 and 0.74473 at 1769900343 with no later data; the attacker's sales exhausted Balancer liquidity. The stolen GYD therefore has no market price independent of the disposal, and the USD loss is valued as realised proceeds.
